# Jibin Johnson

> Jibin Johnson is a freelance web developer and SEO specialist based in Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), Kerala, India. He builds fast, hand-coded websites with technical SEO built in, and runs SEO for businesses that want more enquiries from search. He works in person in Thiruvananthapuram and remotely with clients across India and abroad.

- Location: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India
- Languages: English
- Contact: jibinjohnsoninfo@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 77362 08172
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jibinjohnson · https://github.com/Jibinjohnson11 · https://www.instagram.com/jibineyyyy
- Pricing: no public prices; every project gets a fixed quote after a short call
